prompt: What were the results of the 2025 rooftop solar rebate program?

sources.S1:
A utility filing reports that 2,800 homes installed rooftop solar under the 2025 rebate program. The median system size was 6.2 kilowatts. Installed homes reduced grid electricity purchases by a median of 48 percent over the first year.

The filing notes that installed homes were more likely to be owner-occupied and newer than the service-area average.
sources.S2: An independent audit sampled 150 rebate installations. It found that 9 percent had inverter faults within the first year, most of which were repaired under warranty. The audit did not measure electricity savings.

writer.markdown:
# Question: What were the results of the 2025 rooftop solar rebate program?

## Answer
About 2,800 homes installed rooftop solar under the program [S1]. Installed homes cut grid electricity purchases by a median of 48 percent in the first year [S1].

## Evidence
- The median system size was 6.2 kilowatts [S1].
- An audit of 150 installations found inverter faults in 9 percent within the first year [S2].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- Installed homes were more likely to be owner-occupied and newer, so savings may not generalize [S1].
- The audit did not measure electricity savings [S2].

## Next actions
- Track savings in a matched set of homes without solar (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] Utility rebate filing
- [S2] Independent installation audit
